behaviour: Each reply has one-tap Like and Dislike controls. Changing a vote replaces its contribution. Tentative classification runs privately without web search; uncertainty, provider failure or exhausted call allowance preserves the vote with an unspecified reason. Chat text is not stored in feedback tables. Session-linked vote records are erased with the session; only anonymous category totals remain.
limitations: One-tap ratings do not establish why the user voted; inferred categories remain tentative.
Anonymous aggregate feedback helps identify work for review; it does not automatically train the model or modify prompts or safety rules.
Feedback integrity is session-owned and bounded, but anonymous ratings are not independently verified assessments of clinical correctness.
This task does not complete the pre-existing broader monetary-budget and provider-retention audit.
